The immutable Hub package is the checked public wire/type checkpoint from [AgentOrg PR 56](https://github.com/uniac-ai/AgentOrg/pull/56), source `79508a612121ed17e38e847facc67b02c5ee1954`, merged as `d215d2d91c19c762f4ca78a9b134007c58d40935`. The authoritative Tool descriptions are used without a local override.

`agentorg-cli-79508a61.tgz` has SHA256 `27855fd08de673e3e3404400c80069788a4a376712ba218ef634f4e3e4117c55`. Production imports only its public `@agentorg/cli/contract` schemas/types. Tests additionally launch its public `agentorg-server` command against an owned temporary home and use exported Actor APIs. No sibling checkout or private server/storage imports are used.

The Hub bundles Workspace 0.2.0, source `b2d40d90e26549cacef72a07802df0cf17f7af94`, archive SHA256 `027edf55bfe005e4079dd5cbb49216c6b2d6490c8ed5ae1763953ca5d235b21a`. Its 16 operations include simple P2P Messages and shared Work/Forms; the full Hub catalog has nine Tools and 23 interfaces. Existing runtime homes require a coordinated migration and an authoritative private historical-message baseline; test fixtures always use new empty homes.
